The '''2007–08''' season of the [[Belgium|Belgian]] [[Belgian First Division|First Division]] began on August 3, 2007, and concluded on May 10, 2008. The championship was decided in the 31st round on April 20, 2008, when [[Standard Liège]] beat [[R.S.C. Anderlecht|Anderlecht]] 2–0 at home. For Standard it was their 9th League Championship, but just their first in the last 25 years. At the other end of the table, [[F.C. Molenbeek Brussels Strombeek|Brussels]] and [[K. Sint-Truidense V.V.|Sint-Truiden]] were relegated on matchdays 31 and 32 respectively. Behind Standard, [[R.S.C. Anderlecht|Anderlecht]] and [[Club Brugge]] fought until the end for the second place which gives right to a place in the qualifying rounds of the [[2008–09 UEFA Champions League]]. On the penultimate matchday, Anderlecht won against Club Brugge with 2–0 which proved decisive in the end for them to become second.

==Clubs==
Eighteen teams played in the [[Belgian First Division]] season 2007–08. Twelve teams were from [[Flanders]], four clubs from [[Wallonia]] and two clubs from the [[Brussels-Capital Region]].

===New teams===
[[K.S.K. Beveren]] had been relegated at the end of the previous season with [[F. C. Verbroedering Dender E.H.]] replacing them as they won the [[Belgian Second Division]]. [[Lierse S.K. (1906)|Lierse]] lost their spot during the [[Belgian Second Division final round|promotion playoff]] and were replaced by [[Y.R. K.V. Mechelen]].

==Season statistics==

===Scoring===
*First goal of the season: [[Marcin Wasilewski]] for [[R.S.C. Anderlecht|Anderlecht]] against [[Y.R. K.V. Mechelen|Mechelen]] (3 August 2007)
*Widest winning margin: '''6''': [[K.V.C. Westerlo|Westerlo]] 6–0 [[K.S.V. Roeselare|Roeselare]] (20 October 2007)
*Most goals in a match: '''9''': [[K.V.C. Westerlo|Westerlo]] 7–2 [[F.C. Molenbeek Brussels Strombeek|Brussels]] (19 January 2008)
*Best offensive team: [[Cercle Brugge KSV|Cercle Brugge]] with 62 goals.
*Best defensive team: [[Standard Liège]] with 19 goals.
*Hattricks scored:
** [[Milan Jovanović (footballer, born 1981)|Milan Jovanović]] for [[Standard Liège]] against [[F.C. Molenbeek Brussels Strombeek|Brussels]] (11 August 2007)
** [[Milan Jovanović (footballer, born 1981)|Milan Jovanović]] for [[Standard Liège]] against [[K.S.V. Roeselare|Roeselare]] (25 August 2007)
** [[Joseph Akpala]] for [[R. Charleroi S.C.|Charleroi]] against [[K. Sint-Truidense V.V.|Sint-Truiden]] (26 August 2007)
** [[Bertin Tomou]] for [[R.E. Mouscron|Mouscron]] against [[F.C. Verbroedering Dender E.H.|Dender EH]] (27 October 2007)
** [[Bryan Ruiz]] for [[K.A.A. Gent|Gent]] against [[K.S.C. Lokeren Oost-Vlaanderen|Lokeren]] (8 December 2007)
** [[Elyaniv Barda]] for [[K.R.C. Genk|Genk]] against [[S.V. Zulte Waregem|Zulte-Waregem]] (14 December 2007)
** [[Bart Van Den Eede]] for [[K.V.C. Westerlo|Westerlo]] against [[F.C. Molenbeek Brussels Strombeek|Brussels]] (19 January 2008)
** [[Joseph Akpala]] for [[R. Charleroi S.C.|Charleroi]] against [[K.R.C. Genk|Genk]] (12 April 2008)
** [[Nicolás Frutos]] for [[R.S.C. Anderlecht|Anderlecht]] against [[K. Sint-Truidense V.V.|Sint-Truiden]] (26 April 2008)

===Cards===
*First yellow card: [[Nicolas Pareja]] for [[R.S.C. Anderlecht|Anderlecht]] against [[Y.R. K.V. Mechelen|Mechelen]] (3 August 2007)
*First red card: [[Wim Mennes]] for [[K.V.C. Westerlo|Westerlo]] against [[F.C. Molenbeek Brussels Strombeek|Brussels]] (4 August 2007)
